items.title: For an irreducible subset and a finite union of locally closed subsets the three density conditions are equivalent
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the equivalence of three density conditions for a constructible subset against an irreducible subset (author lemma at source lines 3047-3063, label lemma-generic-point-in-constructible), with the generic-point formulation as the third condition. The proof (source lines 3065-3076) has its content in the step from density to openness: the intersection is a finite union of locally closed pieces, irreducibility selects one dense piece, and local closedness of that piece upgrades density to open density (proof lines 3066-3072); the equivalence with the generic-point condition is then immediate (proof lines 3072-3075). The lemma is used throughout the constructible-sets section. H2.
